description: Public Pages local presentation/media assets addressed by site-root URL path. Asset-specific authorization and stable-v2 release eligibility are recorded below; a hash/inventory match alone is not public-display approval. Raw DICOM and source mesh inputs are excluded. These assets are not relicensed under the wrapper's Apache-2.0 license.

/assets/feature-setup.png.scope: First-party application UI capture with no patient data.

/assets/feature-sample.png.scope: First-party application UI capture using the bundled non-clinical sample.

/assets/benchmark-totalseg.png.scope: Model-output render derived from owner-authorized CT data; raw DICOM excluded.

/assets/benchmark-dentalseg.png.scope: Model-output render derived from owner-authorized CT data; raw DICOM excluded.

/assets/benchmark-toothseg.png.scope: Model-output render derived from owner-authorized CT data; raw DICOM excluded.

/assets/benchmark-slicer.png.scope: Benchmark screenshot containing 3D Slicer UI and marks for nominative comparison; third-party UI and marks are not relicensed.

/assets/old-article-thumbnail.png.scope: Thumbnail of the project owner's 2024 article; embedded third-party UI and marks are not relicensed.

/assets/totalsegmentator-ios-tooth-segme.scope: Model-output render derived from the creator's self-scan of their own oral cavity. The creator explicitly approved public display of this named WebP on 2026-08-03 (Asia/Tokyo). The original PLY remains excluded from distribution. TGNet checkpoints and weights are not included.

/favicon.svg.scope: First-party SVG favicon with no patient or source-scan data.
